allot.subject: Acquisition
allot.text: Insecticides (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about the execution of a Share Subscription and Shareholders  Agreement with FP Alpha Private Limited and the subsequent allotment of 7,86,745 equity shares pursuant to the said agreement.
